# 954. Array of Doubled Pairs

## Solution 1 (time O(nlog(n)), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def canReorderDoubled(self, arr):
        """
        :type arr: List[int]
        :rtype: bool
        """
        cnt = collections.Counter(arr)
        if cnt[0] % 2 != 0:
            return False
        for k in sorted(cnt.keys(), key=lambda x: abs(x)):
            if cnt[k] > cnt[k * 2]:
                return False
            cnt[k * 2] -= cnt[k]
        return True
```
